description: This file defines the ItemVariantsCacheManager class and related functions for caching and retrieving item variant data in an ERP system, utilizing the frappe framework.

classes.name: ItemVariantsCacheManager
classes.description: Manages caching of item variant data, attribute mappings, and optional attributes for a specific item code.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the cache manager with a specific item code.

methods.name: get_item_variants_data
methods.description: Retrieves cached item variants data, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: get_attribute_value_item_map
methods.description: Retrieves cached attribute-value to item mapping, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: get_item_attribute_value_map
methods.description: Retrieves cached item to attribute-value mapping, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: get_optional_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves optional attributes for the item, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: get_ordered_attribute_values
methods.description: Returns ordered attribute values, fetching from cache or database.

methods.name: build_cache
methods.description: Builds cache data for the item, including attributes, variants, and optional attributes.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cache entries related to the item.

methods.name: rebuild_cache
methods.description: Rebuilds cache by clearing and enqueueing cache build task.
